## Data

The databases are:

-   `inc_metr_non_metr.csv` - average chikungunya incidence in metropolitan and non-metropolitan municipalities of each state in each year of analysis 2014-2022.
-   `reg_metr_non_metr.csv` - classification of Brazilian municipalities into metropolitan and non-metropolitan according to the paper's methodology.

```{r}
# Data for incidence
load("tables/inc_reg_met.RData")

```

# Calculation of the decentralization index (𝛹)

Decentralization Index (`𝛹`) is proposed to describe the spread of chikungunya between metropolitan (`M`) and non-metropolitan (`N`) regions in each federal unit or state (`s`), per year (`y`). This metric calculates the ratio between the total incidence in non-metropolitan municipalities (`In(y,s)`) and the total incidence in metropolitan municipalities (`Im(y,s)`), for each state and year, with higher values reflecting the disease transmission decentralization degree, where `C(m,y)` is the total number of cases in municipality `m` in year `y`, and `P(m,y)` is the population in `m`, in year `y`; Ms is the set of metropolitan municipalities in state s.

*Mathematical formula:*

![](formula_descentralization_index.png){fig-align="center"}

*Interpretation:*

`𝛹` \< 1 : Higher incidence in metropolitan areas.

`𝛹` = 1 : Balanced distribution between regions.

`𝛹` \> 1 : Higher incidence in non-metropolitan areas.

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Total incidence of metropolitan region by UF and YEAR
chikvM <- dmetrop %>%
  filter(HIERARCHY == "metropolitana") %>% 
  group_by(ACR_UF, YEAR) %>%  
  summarise(INCM = sum(INCrm))

# Total incidence of non- metropolitan region by UF and YEAR
chikvN <- dmetrop %>%
  filter(HIERARCHY == "nao metropolitana") %>% 
  group_by(ACR_UF, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(INCN = sum(INCrm))

# Joining the tables
df <- chikvN %>%
  left_join(chikvM)

# Calculating the decentralization index
df <- df %>%
  mutate(IND_UF = INCN/INCM)
df %>% map(~mean(is.na(.)))
df %>% filter(is.na(IND_UF)) # 0/0 division

# Replacing NA by zero
df <- df %>% 
  mutate_at(c("IND_UF"), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) 

# Saving final data
write_csv(df, "../tables/index_descentralization.csv")

```

### Chikungunya decentralization index (𝛹) by year and Brazil Federative Unit (Figure 2)

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Changing all measures that are greater than 1 to up to 5, making it easier to view on the plot
df$IND_UF_A <- ifelse(df$IND_UF > 5, 5, df$IND_UF) 

desc_index <- ggplot(df, aes(x = YEAR, y = IND_UF_A, group = ACR_UF, color = "red")) +
  geom_line(stat = "identity", linewidth = 0.8, position = position_dodge(preserve = "single")) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = min(YEAR), y = 1, xend = max(YEAR), yend = 1), 
               color = "cadetblue4", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_geo(~ACR_UF, grid = "br_states_grid1", scales = "free_y") +  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df$YEAR), max(df$YEAR), by = 2)) + 
  labs(x = "Years", y = "Decentralization Index (Ψ)") + 
  theme_minimal() +  # Improves aesthetics
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "cadetblue3"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8)
  )

desc_index

ggsave(desc_index, filename = "decentralization_index_state.png", width = 2500/300, height = 2000/300, dpi = 300, path = "figures", units = "in", device = "png")  

```

### Population distribution by state: non-metropolitan vs. metropolitan regions in Brazil (Figure 3)

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

df2 <- dmetrop %>%
  group_by(HIERARCHY,ACR_UF) %>%
  summarise(total_pop = sum(POP_SIZErm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(REGION, ACR_UF) %>%
  mutate(
    ACR_UF = factor(ACR_UF, levels = unique(ACR_UF))
    )

# graph
pop_dist <- ggplot(df2, aes(x = ACR_UF, y = total_pop, fill = HIERARCHY)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(), labels = comma) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Federative Unit (UF)", y = "Population") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("aquamarine4", "lightsalmon"),
    labels = c("Non-metropolitan", "Metropolitan")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "grey"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey")
  )


pop_dist

# Salvar o gráfico em alta qualidade
ggsave( filename = "population_distribution_state.png",plot = pop_dist, 
        width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300,path = "figures",units = "in", 
        bg = "white")


```
